channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Nike’s Ribbon-Laced Air Force 1 Is Bubble-licious
item.description: Nike's pretty Air Force 1 Low "Pink Foam" sneaker lands with bubblegum pink leather & ribbon shoelaces.

item.title: Nike’s Strappy Outdoor Sandal Has the Mind of a Trail Sneaker
item.description: Nike's ACG Air Deschutz sandal is back for 2026 with its signature strapped-in design & Air tech.

item.title: In Stride with adidas' ADIZERO EVO SL
item.description: Amidst the flow of a waking city, three sartorial pacesetters claim the streets in the adidas ADIZERO EVO SL. Step by step, their strides thread together in a syncopated prelude to the morning’s shared pulse.

item.title: Nike's Quietly Stylish Dad Shoe Dresses in Black Denim
item.description: Nike's Zoom Vomero 5 "Dark Smoke Grey" offers black denim & suede touches for a secretly stylish take on the dad shoe model.

item.title: How "Crazy" Can Black Dr. Martens Really Be?
item.description: How crazy can all-black Dr. Martens shoes be? Allow Japanese retail giant BEAMS to show you with its Dr. Martens Lowell collaboration.

item.title: A GORE-TEX New Balance Dad Shoe So Good It's Basically a Trail Sneaker
item.description: New Balance's 1906 GORE-TEX sneaker essentially enters trail sneaker mode, with quick laces & a techy black colorway.

item.title: adidas' Mega-Thicc Mary Jane Is Its Techiest Ballet Sneaker Yet
item.description: adidas' Adifom Megajane is a wild Mary Jane sneaker featuring the thick, techy soles of the classic Megaride.

item.title: In Pastel Blue, Nike’s AF1 Has Been Spring-Cleaned
item.description: Nike’s AF1 Low just got yet another upgrade. This time in a shiny light blue, making it the ideal cop for your Spring rotation.

item.title: Issey Miyake’s Next Eyewear Innovation? Eight Eyes
item.description: Humans only have two eyes. And yet Issey Miyake's new UROKO sunglasses have eight lenses wrapping around the wearer's head. Go figure!

item.title: Nike Ultra-Cozy Expedition Slipper Is Wonderfully Woven, Japan-Style
item.description: Nike ACG has been relaunched & it's looking promising. Enter, the Nike ACG Rufus SE in a Japanese-style floral finish.
